quantum_representation.encoding: RY(x_i) angle encoding, re-uploaded every layer
quantum_representation.trainable_entanglement: RZZ(theta_ij) per circular-adjacent pair per layer (TRAINABLE interaction strength)

matched_control.family: Random Fourier Features (Rahimi & Recht 2007): cos(W.x + b + phi)
matched_control.fixed: W (random projection directions), b (baseline phase offsets) -- drawn once per seed
matched_control.trainable: phi (K phase-shift parameters), selected via the SAME COBYLA+CV procedure as the quantum block
